metadata.template_note: Traffic ANALYSIS baseline for the in-process OpenSeesPy solver. The load case path, dt, duration and per-node traffic_load_mappings are supplied only by the approval-frozen load Artifact pair (dense 163-column force matrix plus its node/column mapping); this template ships no bundled traffic record and no node list on purpose. traffic_load_mappings is written by the dispatcher with one entry per node, each carrying its own source_column and scale=1.0, because traffic is a moving load: every node owns an independent time history and the OpenSees traffic module would otherwise fall back to applying the whole matrix column at every node.
